mapper.insert: insert into sup_platform_org_rel(platform_id, org_id, create_by, create_time) values(#{platformId}, #{orgId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from sup_platform_org_rel where platform_id = #{platformId} and org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from sup_platform_org_rel where platform_id = #{platformId} and org_id = #{orgId}
